postcard.title: Indoor cat
postcard.note: Woke up with him inside today. Village tabby, already making himself at home.
postcard.caption: Woke up with him inside. No key, no knock — just a tabby already on the tiles.

lines.text: Why are you yelling at me?
I’m enjoying my day here, why are you yelling at me? I don’t make the rules, that’s your problem.
